fact: American Physical Society (APS) is a nonprofit scientific society and premier physics publishing organization
2026 strategic portfolio: 42 initiatives across 5 strategic themes (Enterprise Resilience, Knowledge Creation, Culture & Talent, Professional Experience, Advocacy)
IS department is the most heavily depended upon shared service (31 initiative references across the strategic portfolio)
Publications processes ~67,000 manuscripts annually via PRISM, the peer review and editorial management system
Senior Leadership Team (SLT) is the body of chiefs: CFO/COO, Chief HR Officer, Chief External Affairs Officer, Chief Marketing Officer, Chief Publications Officer, and others
Core Management Team (CMT) is the body of directors and department heads — functional leaders across the organization

Departments: Development, Editorial, Editorial Operations, EPPMO, Ethics, Executive Office, Finance, Global Sales, Human Resources, Information Systems, International Affairs, Marketing, Meetings, Membership, Careers Education and Inclusive Communities, Public Affairs, Publishing, Strategic Communications, Inclusion and Collaboration
All Staff meetings are APS-wide meetings with all staff. All Minds is an IS department-specific staff meeting. These are separate from the Annual Leadership Meeting (ALM), which is a broader event.

Organizational culture exhibits significant skepticism about AI adoption — concerns include job displacement, environmental impact, ethics, copyright, and whether AI improves outcomes. Senior leadership conservative on AI rollout.
Brand palette: Brand Blue (#00538B), Brand Teal (#00B4D8), Purple (#1F1C6B), Orange (#FF8F1C); typography: Jost (sans-serif) and Faustina (serif)

Fathom is the primary meeting transcript intelligence tool. Zoom's transcription and AI summarization tools are also used. Some meetings are documented through shared Google Docs with running agendas.
